rationale: The release host has 2 vCPU and 3.6 GiB RAM; the policy reserves most memory for the OS and concurrent control-plane work by limiting a serial clean warm to 1 GiB RSS.
A one-hour hard limit keeps a first large-repository build operationally bounded while the 30-minute target records remaining performance debt.
No-op warm is expected to be substantially cheaper; 60 seconds is the hard release limit and 30 seconds is the target.
Eventuate runtime delivery, transaction commit, dispatch, payload values, and compensation execution remain outside static TMF evidence and are accepted only as declared PARTIAL boundaries.
